arch-map.replaces: globbing and grepping to rediscover the package structure every session
arch-map.summary: Where code lives: slices, paths, owned classes, dependency rules
arch-map.use_when: before searching the tree for anything — locate by slice instead of globbing

check-issue.replaces: reading a ticket and judging by feel whether it is implementable
check-issue.summary: Validate a local issue file: Gherkin, tier, constraints, outcome
check-issue.use_when: before starting work from a markdown ticket, or in CI on issue open

coverage-gaps.summary: Uncovered lines, scoped to the files changed on this branch
coverage-gaps.use_when: the coverage gate failed, or you need to know what is untested in your diff

issue-context.replaces: shelling out to gh and parsing issue JSON by hand
issue-context.summary: GitHub issue -> validated work brief; refuses bad tickets, stops on tier-3
issue-context.use_when: step 1 of /work, always, before any planning or code

lexicon.replaces: re-deriving the same non-obvious discovery every session
lexicon.summary: Durable memory: how we solved this class of problem before
lexicon.use_when: BEFORE working anything out from scratch — search it first; add an entry after

mutation-survivors.summary: Surviving mutants and where they are, in ~15 lines
mutation-survivors.use_when: after -Pmutation, or whenever asked to improve the mutation score

pr.replaces: gh pr create / gh pr edit with a body nobody checked against the ticket
pr.summary: Create or update a PR body, or refuse: validates the template against the issue's scenarios
pr.use_when: the ONLY way to write a PR body here — `gh pr create` and `gh pr edit` are both denied
